title: 由同高三角形的底边比求面积
stem:
如图所示，在\(\vartriangle ABC\)中，已知点\(D\)、\(E\)、\(F\)分别是\(BC\)、\(AD\)、\(CE\)的中点，且\(\vartriangle ABC\)的面积为64，则\(\vartriangle BEF\)的面积是（    ）．
〔图1〕
given_solution:
【分析】本题考查了三角形的面积，三角形中线的性质．根据三角形的中线把三角形分成面积相等的两个小三角形得出\(S_{ \Delta AEB } =S_{ \Delta DEB }\)，\(S_{ \Delta AEC } =S_{ \Delta DEC }\)，\(S_{ \Delta DEB } =S_{ \Delta DEC }\)，再根据\(\Delta ABC\)的面积即可求出\(\vartriangle BEC\)的面积，从而求出\(\vartriangle BEF\)的面积．
【详解】解：\(\because\)点\(E\)是\(AD\)的中点，
\(\therefore S_{ \Delta AEB } =S_{ \Delta DEB }\)，\(S_{ \Delta AEC } =S_{ \Delta DEC }\)，
\(\because\)点\(D\)是\(BC\)的中点，
\(\therefore S_{ \Delta DEB } =S_{ \Delta DEC }\)，
\(\therefore S_{ \Delta AEB } =S_{ \Delta DEB } =S_{ \Delta AEC } =S_{ \Delta DEC }\)，
\(\because \vartriangle ABC\)的面积为64，
\(\therefore S_{ \Delta AEB } =S_{ \Delta DEB } =S_{ \Delta AEC } =S_{ \Delta DEC } =16\)，
\(\therefore S_{ \Delta BEC } =S_{ \Delta DEB } +S_{ \Delta DEC } =32\)，
\(\because\)点\(F\)是\(CE\)的中点，
\(\therefore\)\(S_{ \Delta BEF } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }S_{ \Delta BEC } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }\times 32=16\)，
故选：B．
